This script generates the MIC distribution plots 

```{r setup, include=FALSE, message=F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
subdir_name <- "Rscripts/8_mosdepth"
library(here)
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

data = here::here("data")
results_path = here::here("results")

```

```{r knit, echo = F,eval=F,warning=F,include=F}
results_path = here::here("results")
rmarkdown::render(input = here("scripts", str_c(subdir_name, ".Rmd")), output_dir = results_path)
```

# Load data
```{r environmental, echo= F}
# Pad naar jouw mosdepth-regions output
bed_files <- list.files(glue::glue("{data}/mosdepth"),full.names = T)

get_regions = function(region_file) {
  df = fread(region_file,
  col.names = c("chrom", "start", "end", "depth"))[, `:=`(
  mid = (start + end) / 2,
  sample = str_replace(basename(region_file),'\\.regions\\.bed\\.gz','')
)] }

regions = lapply(bed_files, get_regions)

regions_all <- rbindlist(regions)
depth_stats = regions_all[,.(mean_depth = mean(depth,na.rm=T)), by = sample]

regions_all <- merge(
  regions_all,
  depth_stats,
  by = "sample"
)

highlight_regions <- data.table(
  chrom = c("BLWE01000008", "BLWE01000010"),
  start = c(581899,  90551),
  end   = c(585491,  94312)
)
regions_all[, depth_norm := depth / mean_depth]

chrom_to_plot <- "BLWE01000008"

dat_plot <- regions_all[chrom == chrom_to_plot]
hl <- highlight_regions[chrom == chrom_to_plot]

p0 = ggplot(dat_plot, aes(x = mid, y = depth_norm, colour = sample)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_rect(
    data = hl,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "red", alpha = 1
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = paste("Normalized coverage with highlight -", chrom_to_plot),
    x = "Genomic position",
    y = "Normalized depth"
  )



```
